blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Former Sandiganbayan Presiding Justice Amparo Cabotaje-Tang has admitted that there is no need for public officials to declare as cash on bank the funds that merely passed through their accounts — or funds that were deposited but eventually withdrawn.
